title: Score
description: One rubric dimension applied to one entity (EVALUATION.md). Ordinal 1-5. Never aggregated into a stored composite — composites are computed per-persona at query time.

value.description: null means not_scored. Never imputed, never defaulted to average.

rationale.description: One sentence. Mandatory. This is what makes the score auditable; the number alone is an opinion in a numeric costume.

via.description: Conditions the score depends on. Required for D1/D2/D3/D5 on models, which are always scored through a harness.

confidence.description: COMPUTED. Floor of input confidences, not the average.

belief.description: COMPUTED belief distribution over {1..5} (DECISION.md §1). A score is not 4; it is a distribution whose spread comes from evidence strength and WIDENS with age — we do not become wrong about an old score, we become less sure. The engine sees this, never the point value.

mass.description: Probability mass over scores 1..5. Sums to 1.

heuristic_version.description: Belief shapes come from published, versioned heuristics about evidence strength. Reasonable people would construct them differently — versioning is mitigation, not a solution (DECISION.md §12).

anchor_set_version.description: EVALUATION.md version the anchors came from. Anchors drift as the ceiling rises; longitudinal comparison of raw scores across anchor versions is invalid.

second_pass.description: Independent re-score from the same evidence. Divergence >= 2 triggers re-examination (EVALUATION.md §6).

then.description: A scored dimension must have a rationale and evidence. No exceptions.
